name: Women's service cap (bucket cap), cadet officers
size_basis: Width 8.2 in kept (head ~22.5 in, as base-art/hats.js); outline measured from the CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-9 service cap (width : height = 1.705), so height 4.81 in. The regulation gives no cap dimensions.
provenance: outline traced per column from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-9 (women's service caps, p.140); crown plate and lower seam lines read off the figure
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); device_slot is a nominal box centred where the CAP service cap insignia sits (centred on the front)

dimensions.visor: blue (women's service cap visor is blue, 6.2.1.3.3)
dimensions.difference_note: cadet officer cap: same cap body as the officer/NCO cap; the difference is the device (cap-device-cadet-officer-service) and no clouds or darts (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)

documented: rounded design, sides form a front brim, solid blue hat cover (6.2.1.2.1)
Maj Gen / Brig Gen crown band: three clouds and darts per side; Col / Lt Col / Maj: two per side (Fig A5-9, 6.2.1.3.1-2)
cadet officers wear the cadet service cap insignia; no clouds or darts
